svg.text: Dee's Seven Tables of Creation (Sloane MS 3188 ff. 37v-38r), as drawn by Whitby (1982)
Table 1 centre; 2 and 3 above; 7 left, 4 right; 6 and 5 below. Shaded: lost or fragmentary; purple frame: entry that does not fit Dee's name list; red glyphs: known only from Ashmole's 1672 copy.
Table 2 lost entries: 13R, 30R, 36N, 41A - 6 possible placements (3 different letter patterns).
Table 3 lost entries: 4S, 5U, 6A, 13I, 19A, 28I, 37A, 38R, 44G, 48R - 1080 possible placements allowed by the surviving fragments.
No construction rule passed the pre-registered held-out test, so no cell is restored (results/rules.json).
